title: cyperus litoreus
intro: Cyperus litoreus, commonly known as the beach sedge or seaside flatsedge, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family. This plant is native to tropical and subtropical regions, particularly in coastal areas. Cyperus litoreus is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
